description: A section heading set in bold body-sized type (10pt, same as the surrounding text) rather than a larger font. classify_regions's only heading signal is SECTION_HEADER_FONT_FACTOR (font size >= 1.15x the body median); this crate's Char/Line/Block model carries no bold/weight flag at all, so a same-size bold heading is indistinguishable from body text and defaults to RegionClass::Text.

lines.text: This section presents the results of the experiment in detail across multiple paragraphs.
